$comment: Org-wide managed settings for infra-copilot on Claude Code. Copy to the managed
settings path for your platform (see docs/policy.md) and edit before deploying —
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly locks the rule set, so an incomplete list here
blocks work rather than merely failing to restrict it.
The rules are derived from what the plugin actually invokes, not from a guess:
terraform fmt/init/login/plan/validate/version, mise, jq, gh api/auth, curl,
cf-terraforming, gcloud, git rev-parse. terraform apply and destroy appear nowhere
in the manifest, which is why they are denied outright.
pluginTrustMessage: infra-copilot may read your HCP Terraform token to drive the HCP API. It never applies Terraform: apply and destroy are denied.
